epithet: Teller of the Thousand and One Nights
quote: "And morning overtook Shahrazad, so she fell silent."
question: A thousand nights, a new story each one. What does a woman who survived on words alone wear?
why_en: The Night is the dark itself — saffron, rose, oud and amber, a perfume heavy enough to last until dawn.
why_ar: وغايدنس هي الحكاية: كمثرى ولبانٌ وزعفران وياسمين — الصوت الهادئ الذي أنقذ صاحبته دون سيف.
